parsed.post: The last attempt to decrease learning rate slightly (0.837) resulted in a regression from our best (0.834). It appears the model is already near its stability peak with the current MATRIX_LR. I will revert to the best commit and try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to see if more context improves compression.
parsed.description: Reverting to best commit 692c13d and increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to explore if larger spatial context improves val_bpb.
